verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only role-based access control: custom roles, permissions assigned to roles, organization-scoped roles, IdP role assignment, and enforcement through session JWTs. There is no evidence of resource-level, relationship-based (ReBAC/FGA) or policy-engine authorization beyond roles. The phrase "enforce access policies" appears only in the context of role permissions, so it is an adjacent capability rather than the one the story asks for.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can express fine-grained, resource-level authorization (relationship- or policy-based) beyond simple roles
